text:
elaine-ml: Heads up — EU2 GPU warm pools are failing to finish onboarding since ~08:10 UTC. Nodes are stuck decrypting model artifacts, kubelet logs show repeated KMS errors. Anyone seen this?
raj-infra: seeing the same. Cloud fw rollout (rule id fw-17231) went out at 08:12. I can correlate deny entries to ephemeral node subnets.
sam-sre: pinging logs — got this from a failing node: 
```
2026-03-23T08:14:57Z kubelet: error decrypting key: KMS_DECRYPT_ERR: Post "https://kms.eu2.internal/": dial tcp 10.23.5.12:443: connect: connection refused
```
raj-infra: FW rule blocked outbound to 10.23.0.0/16 (intent was to block external log sinks pending audit). That prefix contains our keystore endpoints in eu2. Bad carveout. :grimacing:
claire-sec: that rule was intentional — we pushed a default-deny egress baseline to cut accidental exfil. We scoped it to known audit collectors but looks like we missed keystore. We can add exceptions.
elaine-ml: Can we get a temporary exception ASAP? Provisioning is stuck and autoscaler is spinning retries (cost spike).
sam-sre: +1. Autoscaler has retried node creation ~12 times per AZ; seeing failed join churn and billing increase. Suggest immediate rollback of fw-17231 or add explicit allow for kms.eu2.redwood-internal and auditshipper endpoints.
raj-infra: I can rollback the firewall rule but need approval from sec. Alternatively I can patch the rule to allow tcp:443 to 10.23.0.0/16 (keystore) and 10.33.0.0/24 (auditshipper). Which do you want?
claire-sec: temporary allow for keystore only. We must not open auditshipper to wide range yet. I'll approve rollback if it's a targeted exception.
raj-infra: executing patch now — `cloud-fw patch fw-17231 --allow-egress 10.23.0.0/16:443 --comment "temp keystore exception - emergency"`
deploy-bot: Firewall fw-17231 patch started by raj-infra at 2026-03-23T08:28:07Z. Change id ch-9012.
elaine-ml: thank you. Observability: nodes still retrying but some started to get past decrypt step.
sam-sre: watching kube events — one node joined at 08:33:14, another at 08:34:02. Warm pool count rising.
claire-sec: logging the exception and opening a ticket for follow-up. We need an RFC to migrate keystore to privatelink endpoints or service endpoints so fw rules can be tighter.
raj-infra: rollback not needed — we applied target allow and left default-deny. Patch completed at 08:29:55. ch-9012 closed.
elaine-ml: by 08:42 all pending nodes finished onboarding, +64 GPUs available. Autoscaler stopped spinning. Cost spike capped. :relieved:
sam-sre: I'll run a quick postmortem blameless note and capture metrics for retry count and expected unit-cost impact.
claire-sec: follow-up actions: 1) RFC for keystore privatelink by next sprint, 2) add pre-deploy test that verifies keystore reachability when fw baseline changes, 3) update runbook to call out fw-17231 carveouts. I'll file PRs.
elaine-ml: Ack — please also add a step to warm pools to retry less aggressively on decrypt errors to avoid cost churn.
raj-infra: noted. Will update autoscaler backoff param and create a short changelog.
sam-sre: tagging incident: #eu2-keystore-fw-block (for tracking). Closing thread after postmortem.
deploy-bot: Change ch-9012 recorded in changelog and linked to incident #eu2-keystore-fw-block.
